content.text: Fedora has been working fine and we've been ingesting works, currently around 10k, for the past couple of days before this error started.
Our repository file:
-rw-rw-r-- 1 tomcat tomcat 19522039808 Jul 12 07:37 modeshape.repository
Here's a copy of our repository.json

I saw reference to best practices allocating RAM for Fedora, and currently we have much more allocated to Tomcat than what the documentation suggests as a "maximum". Could this be causing the problem?

/usr/java/latest/bin/java 
-Djava.util.logging.config.file=/usr/local/tomcat/conf/logging.properties 
-Djava.util.logging.manager=org.apache.juli.ClassLoaderLogManager 
-Xminf0.1 
-Xmaxf0.3 
-Xmx4096M 
-Xms3072M 
-XX:NewSize=1200M 
-Dfcrepo.home=/data0/fedora 
-Dfcrepo.modeshape.configuration=file:/usr/local/tomcat/conf/repository.json 
-Dhydra 
-Djava.awt.headless=true 
-XX:+UseParallelOldGC 
-javaagent:/usr/local/tomcat/newrelic/newrelic.jar 
-Djava.endorsed.dirs=/usr/local/tomcat/common/endorsed 
-classpath /usr/local/tomcat/bin/bootstrap.jar:/usr/local/tomcat/bin/tomcat-juli.jar 
-Dcatalina.base=/usr/local/tomcat 
-Dcatalina.home=/usr/local/tomcat 
-Djava.io.tmpdir=/usr/local/tomcat/temp 
org.apache.catalina.startup.Bootstrap start
Can you provide the full stacktrace?
Do you have suggestions on how to reproduce this error?
Two recommendations:
please use Fedora 4.7.3 (
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FF/Fedora+4.7.3+Release+Notes)
please use a database storage for you objects (
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FEDORA473/Configuring+JDBC+Object+Store)

I am happy to explore this issue with the underlying ModeShape team, but in any case, you are highly recommended to use a database instead of the file-store for your objects. The file-store is provided for simple testing, not production.
You may not, but if you have a scripted set of commands that reproduce this situation from an empty repository, it would likely make it easier for the ModeShape team to address the issue.
If, however, you plan on moving to a database backend, I would be inclined to lower the priority of this issue.
I'm going to get the database created, and migrate the objects over before we take it any further. Thanks for your time work thus far!
Migrating from the flat file to the database using details at (
https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FEDORA471/RESTful+HTTP+API+-+Backup+and+Restore
) solved the problem.
I'm guessing we bumped up against a limitation of the size of a file based modeshape repository.
I think we can close this ticket.
Using the Hyrax web application, when creating a new work we get failures. The problem seems to come from the following exception:

comments.body:
Fedora has been working fine and we've been ingesting works, currently around 10k, for the past couple of days before this error started.

 

Our repository file:

-rw-rw-r-- 1 tomcat tomcat 19522039808 Jul 12 07:37 modeshape.repository

Here's a copy of our repository.json 

 

{
"name" : "repo",
"jndiName" : "",
"workspaces" : {
  "predefined" : ["default"],
  "default" : "default",
  "allowCreation" : true
},
"storage" : {
  "persistence": {
  "type": "file",
  "path" : "${fcrepo.object.directory:target/objects}"
},
"binaryStorage" : {
  "type" : "file",
  "directory" : "${fcrepo.binary.directory:target/binaries}",
  "minimumBinarySizeInBytes" : 4096
}
},
"security" : {
  "anonymous" : {
    "roles" : ["readonly","readwrite","admin"],
    "useOnFailedLogin" : false
  },
  "providers" : [
    { "classname" : "org.fcrepo.auth.common.BypassSecurityServletAuthenticationProvider" }
  ]
},
"node-types" : ["fedora-node-types.cnd"]
}

I am happy to explore this issue with the underlying ModeShape team, but in any case, you are highly recommended to use a database instead of the file-store for your objects. The file-store is provided for simple testing, not production.

You may not, but if you have a scripted set of commands that reproduce this situation from an empty repository, it would likely make it easier for the ModeShape team to address the issue.

If, however, you plan on moving to a database backend, I would be inclined to lower the priority of this issue.
I'm going to get the database created, and migrate the objects over before we take it any further. Thanks for your time work thus far!

Migrating from the flat file to the database using details at (https://wiki.duraspace.org/display/FEDORA471/RESTful+HTTP+API+-+Backup+and+Restore) solved the problem. 

 

I'm guessing we bumped up against a limitation of the size of a file based modeshape repository.
I think we can close this ticket.
